Non s ubmission of relevant documents wrt above points will result in outright rejection of the bid 2. Manufacturer's Authorization Form (M AF) for Server specifying bid number for participating in this tender is mandatory for bidders and should be attached along with the bid. om the OEM 4. Bidder shall submit details of Single Point of Contact (SPOC) who is responsible for resolution for all issu es.
